title: Ninety-five Theses
summary: Martin Luther posts (or circulates) theses against indulgences, a spark of the Protestant Reformation.

title: Magellan–Elcano circumnavigation
summary: A Spanish-backed expedition completes the first circumnavigation; Magellan dies in the Philippines.

title: Fall of Tenochtitlan
summary: Cortés and a broad Indigenous alliance capture Tenochtitlan after siege and epidemic.

title: Seizure of Atahualpa at Cajamarca
summary: Pizarro captures the Inca ruler Atahualpa, opening the rapid collapse of Tawantinsuyu’s political centre.

title: De revolutionibus orbium coelestium
summary: Copernicus publishes a heliocentric astronomy, dedicated to the pope, in the year of his death.

title: Battle of Lepanto
summary: A Holy League fleet defeats the Ottomans in the Gulf of Patras.

title: Spanish Armada
summary: Philip II’s invasion fleet fails against England, wrecked by fighting and weather.

title: Mughal Empire
summary: Timurid-Mughal rule in South Asia from Babur’s victory at Panipat to the aftermath of 1857.
